name: @duplocode/lease
description: In-memory bounded leases for worker, model-route, and event-ingest authority. Leases require explicit limits, an issuer, a subject, and an expiry-boundary string. Validity is evaluated only against a caller-supplied time boundary: the store never reads the wall clock and never auto-expires on its own. Expired, revoked, or unknown leases surface as unavailable, never as valid.
